title: Meta AI's new Mac app wants you to talk to your apps | TechCrunch
summary: Meta today announced a new Mac app for Meta AI with built-in system-wide dictation. Meta has increasingly focused on making its AI tools available to businesses for automated customer support and inquiries across its apps, including WhatsApp and Instagram.
